basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old financial advisor based in Toronto, Canada, with a keen interest in alternative investments and collectibles. From vintage guitars to rare hockey cards, I enjoy exploring diverse asset classes. I also have a soft spot for retro video games, although I've recently shifted focus towards equities. In my downtime, I jam on my guitar and follow the latest in speculative evolution. I'm usually active on Reddit during evenings and weekends. Currently in a long-term relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in finance and have been working in the investment sector for over a decade. My knowledge extends to traditional investments as well as collectibles, thanks to both professional experience and personal passion. Frequent discussions with clients and fellow enthusiasts keep me updated on market trends.
